# Segment Information

The Group's main retail clothing business is divided into four reportable operating segments: UNIQLO Japan, UNIQLO International, GU and Global Brands, each of which is used to frame and form the Group's strategy.

## Geographic notes

Revenue is classified by nation or region based on customer location. Greater China: Mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan.

| Market | Revenue | Percent of Total |
|--------|---------|------------------|
| Japan | 1,026,096 | 30.2 |
| Greater China | 650,232 | 19.1 |

Notes: 1. Units are millions of yen. Greater China is not PRC. Japan segment revenue is not geographic Japan.

# Risks

Suitable-site access and hiring delays may constrain store openings in Japan. This is not evidence that an acquisition would transfer Fast Retailing capabilities.
